meta.description: Eval set for the CHOICE bucket matching pipeline (Phase 6 of CLAUDE_CODE_BUILD_BRIEF.md). 34 realistic objective statements spanning different domains, each with a human-labeled set of buckets that SHOULD reasonably appear in the top-5 tooltip. Cases 1-18 were the original Phase 6 set; cases 19-23 (added 2026-08-22) target Ethics/Privacy/Sustainability/Accessibility/Localization; cases 24-28 (round 2) target Lessons Learned/Communication/Monitoring/Dependencies/Quality; cases 29-34 (round 3) target Competition/Competitive Landscape/Constraints/Assumptions/External Environment/Innovation/Problem Definition/ROI -- the last of the buckets no prior case had ever raw-matched. Use to measure precision/recall before shipping, and any time bucket_library.json's synonym lists change.
meta.how_to_score: For each test case, run the statement through the matching pipeline, take its top-5 predicted buckets, and compare to expected_buckets. A 'hit' is any predicted bucket whose base name (ignore _v2/tier suffixes) matches an expected bucket name. Report hits/misses per case, then aggregate precision (hits / 5) and recall (hits / len(expected_buckets)) across all cases.

Before deciding whether to enter the ride-hailing market in Indonesia, analyze our top three competitors' pricing and market share to understand the competitive landscape and identify a defensible point of differentiation.
Assess the key assumptions and known constraints -- budget, headcount, and the Q4 holiday freeze -- before committing to a Q4 launch date for the new checkout redesign.
Evaluate how new tariffs and a slowing consumer economy might affect our expansion plans before finalizing next year's growth targets.
Explore three innovative approaches to reduce packaging waste for our shipping boxes, including a reusable container pilot, before our sustainability report is due next quarter.
